failure_modes.mode: Submit occurs without fresh human approval
failure_modes.cause: Legacy flags, raw browser tools, forged actor/session or client manifest
failure_modes.detection: Zero-transaction fixture counters for all unapproved/unregistered paths
failure_modes.mitigation: Existing live actuators remain nonconfigurably contained; only owned registered fixture executor can consume authority

failure_modes.mode: Reviewed payload changes or approval replays
failure_modes.detection: Byte/country/rights/field/consent edits, expiry/replay and simultaneous-consume fixtures
failure_modes.mitigation: Exact current manifest, actor/session/boot binding, short expiry and durable atomic CAS consume

failure_modes.mode: Crash/lost receipt is called prepared and retried
failure_modes.cause: No durable intent or outcome ambiguity ignored
failure_modes.detection: Before/after-dispatch crash and missing receipt fixtures
failure_modes.mitigation: Persist submitting intent first; consumed interrupted attempt remains uncertain until explicit reconciliation; no automatic replay

failure_modes.mode: Synthetic test coverage advertised as live ATS support
failure_modes.cause: Approval controls confused with arbitrary-site network mediation
failure_modes.detection: Real-target negative tests and explicit readiness register
failure_modes.mitigation: No live adapter activated; synthetic adapter cannot network; unsupported real sites use manual handoff and retain live containment

failure_modes.mode: Migration/import revives authority or breaks positional writers
failure_modes.cause: Added browser fields and copied approval JSON
failure_modes.detection: Migration rerun, explicit-column writes, restart and restore tests
failure_modes.mitigation: Additive schema, boot/session invalidation, imported authority revocation and uncertain recovery
